entries.source_quote: Deathbringer Stance's damage applies life steal at 100% effectiveness. Aatrox heals for 100% of the post-mitigation bonus damage dealt, reduced to 25% against minions.

At 7 stacks, Alistar consumes them all to heal himself for 5% of his maximum health and nearby allied champions for 7% of his maximum health.

Severum's attacks heal Aphelios for 2% : 7.1% (based on level) of the post-mitigation damage dealt, increased to 5% : 17.75% (based on level) for attacks from abilities.

In return, he gains bonus attack speed, 50% bonus-armor penetration, and 20% omnivamp, and modifies his basic abilities which can be cast at no cost.

Whenever a nearby enemy dies, Trundle heals himself for 1.8% : 5.5% (based on level) of the target's maximum health.

Trundle drains the life force out of the target enemy champion, dealing magic damage and healing himself for the same amount. Total Magic Damage: 30% of target's max HP at rank 3; the other half applied every second over the next 4 seconds.
Active: Tryndamere consumes all of his Fury to heal himself, increased for every point of Fury consumed. Maximum Heal: 300 (+ 150% AP) at rank 5 with full 100 Fury.
Recast - Awaken: causes the empowered attacks to instead gain doubled life steal... Increased Life Steal: 40% at rank 6.
